title: Inventory of personal content per table, with proposed retention limits
goal: One page lists every SQLite table and file that holds personal content, how long it is kept today, and a proposed limit with its reason
acceptance: Every table in the schema is listed or named as holding no personal content
States whether mail text already lands in sortie results, episodes or memory since F-086-T02
Proposed limits as options for the owner; the 7-snapshot and off-host copy lag is stated
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: read the schema and write one options page. Not a measurement.
